# This test abuses the flexibility of the token auth mechanism to test
# it by faking a Basic Authentication using the token auth construction.
# The two cases below are the same as the cases for the basic_auth_config
# test, but done explicitly.

serve hello.text user password
expand src_var.cel src.cel
cmpenv src.cel src_var.cel 

mito -use http -cfg cfg_good.yaml src.cel
cmp stdout want_good.txt

mito -use http -cfg cfg_bad.yaml src.cel
cmp stdout want_bad.txt

-- src_var.cel --
// $URL is set by the serve command and ${URL} is expanded by the expand command.
string(get("${URL}").Body)
-- hello.text --
hello
-- cfg_good.yaml --
auth:
  token:
    type: Basic
    value: dXNlcjpwYXNzd29yZA==
-- want_good.txt --
"hello\n"
-- cfg_bad.yaml --
auth:
  token:
    type: Basic
    value: dXNlcjpsZXRtZWlu
-- want_bad.txt --
"password mismatch"
